Components.Name: VirtualGamepad
Components.Description: A gamepad on the screen for the fingers: a stick, buttons and triggers; a pad of the Gamepad Service as a real one.

Props.Name: Buttons
Props.Description: The buttons it shows: a, b, x, y, lb, rb, lt, rt, start, select (a list, or a text with commas).

Props.Name: Right
Props.Description: A second stick, at the right, to look round.

Props.Name: Show
Props.Description: auto: where the screen is touched; always; never.

Props.Name: Tilt
Props.Description: The left stick across follows the lean of the device as a wheel.

Props.Name: Navigate
Props.Description: Its buttons also move the focus and press the controls of the page, as a real pad does.

Props.Name: Size
Props.Description: The size of a stick, in pixels.

Props.Name: Label
Props.Description: The name of the pad for screen readers.

EventDescriptions.button: A button went down or up: {Button, Down}.

Services.Name: Math
Services.Description: The numbers of space: matrices, vectors, rays and a smooth noise, the same in a page, a worker and Node.
Methods: Orthographic(left, right, bottom, top, near, far)

Services.Name: Noise
Services.Description: The noise of space by any algorithm (value, perlin, simplex, worley, white), with fractals, warp, tiling, terraces and blends, the same in a shader.

Services.Name: Random
Services.Description: Random numbers of a seed: always the same numbers for the same seed.

Services.Name: Pathfinding
Services.Description: The ways across a map: A*, Dijkstra and flow fields on a grid, A* on a graph of your own.

Services.Name: Visibility
Services.Description: What can be seen on a grid: lines, the line of sight, the field of view and the fog of war.

Services.Name: Workers
Services.Description: Work of the Services of the library off the main thread: workers made of the source of their methods.

Services.Name: Archive
Services.Description: Archives made in the page: a zip of texts and bytes by their paths, to download a project or a game in one file.

Services.Name: Astronomy
Services.Description: The numbers of a star system: Kepler orbits, stars and planets, their warmth, and whole systems of a seed.

Services.Name: Diff
Services.Description: The differences between two texts (the algorithm of Myers: the shortest list of changes).

Services.Name: Formulas
Services.Description: Formulas written as in LaTeX, drawn by the browser as MathML.

Services.Name: DataFormats
Services.Description: The formats of data and of files: JSON, YAML, CSV, INI, TOML, XML, query strings and Base64 read and written, and formats of your own.

Services.Name: Signatures
Services.Description: How much a signature looks like another or like the samples of a person: a help for an interface, not a check of security.

Services.Name: Calculations
Services.Description: Formulas of numbers read without eval: variables, functions, conditions.

Services.Name: FPS
Services.Description: How smoothly a page draws, with WebGL or without: frames per second, the times of frames and what draws tells of its own.

Services.Name: Syntax
Services.Description: The highlighting of source code: the grammars of the languages and the tokens of a text in one of them.

Services.Name: SpatialIndex
Services.Description: Where things are on a plane, found fast: a grid of buckets for the queries of a rectangle, a radius and the nearest.

Services.Name: Loop
Services.Description: The loop of a game or of any world: updates in steps of the same time, drawn once a frame.

Services.Name: Seeded
Services.Description: What is made of a seed, saved and made again: its recipe by default, the data made too when baked.

Services.Name: Physics
Services.Description: How things move, apart from what shows them: steps of one length, springs, a car on its tyres and springs, a ship in space, a boat on the waves, a world of solid bodies with ragdolls and water to float in, cloth and ropes, waves and a fluid of particles.
Methods: Spring(value, speed, target, stiffness, damping, elapsed)
Gearbox(state, input, settings, gas, braking, speed, elapsed)
Boat(state, input, sea, bed, settings, elapsed)

Services.Name: Blueprints
Services.Description: Graphs of blocks in the JSON of Flowprint, made into code and flows of actions (and into shaders by BlueprintShaders).

Services.Name: QR
Services.Description: QR codes: Encode(text, level) returns the modules of the code of a text, SVG(text, options) a drawing of it, styled.

Services.Name: Barcodes
Services.Description: Barcodes: Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF-14, DataMatrix, PDF417 and formats of its own, drawn in SVG.

Services.Name: InputDevices
Services.Description: What the player presses, leans and moves: keys, the pointer, touches, gamepads, the motion of the device, and actions bound to them.

Services.Name: Achievements
Services.Description: The achievements of an Application of any kind, as data: definitions, progress and unlocks, with events; stored by the Application (Export, Import).

Directives.Name: swipe
Directives.Description: *swipe makes an element follow a finger (a pen, or a mouse with Mouse) along an axis and tells the end of the move: *swipe, *swipe="'y'" or *swipe="{Axis: 'x' or 'y', Threshold: 40, Mouse: false}".

Directives.Name: draggable
Directives.Description: *draggable="{Data: item, Type: 'task', Handle: '.grip'}" (or just *draggable="item") lets the element be dragged with the pointer onto *droppable elements that accept Type.

Directives.Name: droppable
Directives.Description: *droppable="{Accept: ['task'], Files: true, Text: true}" makes the element a drop target.

Directives.Name: resizable
Directives.Description: *resizable="'right bottom'" adds resize handles to the element: right, left, bottom, top and corner (bottom right).

Directives.Name: infinite
Directives.Description: *infinite asks for more (the event more) when the end of a list comes near: *infinite="{Margin: 300, Direction: 'down' or 'up', Busy: false, Done: false}".

Directives.Name: mount
Directives.Description: *mount="source" places custom content in the element: source is a DOM node (moved in), a function (called once with the element) or an object with Element or Render(container, item).
